info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Details Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Account Details Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about specific customer accounts. By providing a unique customer ID and account ID, consumers can retrieve key account data, including balance, transaction history, and account status. This API is designed for financial institutions and customer service platforms that require quick access to account information. It facilitates transparency and enhances customer support capabilities by providing real-time insights into customers' accounts.

get.summary: Retrieve account details for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific account associated with a customer. Providing the customer ID and account ID will return all relevant details pertaining to the account.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the detailed information associated with a specific account belonging to a customer. The request should include necessary identifiers to locate the account correctly.

GetCustomerAccountDetailsRequest.title: Get Account Details Request Body
GetCustomerAccountDetailsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving account details for a specific customer and account.

GetCustomerAccountDetailsResponse_200.title: Account Details Response

routingNumber.description: The routing number associated with the account.

realAccountNumber.description: The actual account number of the customer.

GetCustomerAccountDetailsResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response structure for retrieving account details.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID for tracking requests across systems.

ResponseMetadata.description: Contains metadata information related to the API response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: This header contains the identifier for the endpoint being accessed, allowing tracking of the specific API endpoint being utilized.

X-Runtime-App.description: This header indicates the application responsible for executing the request, offering insight into the application layer handling the operation.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication method using a Bearer token in the HTTP Authorization header. Tokens are encoded as JSON Web Tokens (JWT), which securely transmit information between parties.
